developmentInterpretation.note: Positive drop-column values mean the selector lost accuracy after that token group was removed and the model was relearned. Negative values indicate conditional redundancy in this synthetic population, not scientific uselessness.

evidenceAttribution.note: Local curvature shares describe where ROI precision came from. They do not prove that a source is valid or causal.

claimBoundary: The evidence establishes external synthetic transport under the declared AMSS adapter, candidate pool, inference contract, and utility. It does not establish real-advertiser effectiveness or universal state-of-the-art performance.
